third_party_source: Original saved sources compiled without edits; not copied into published measurement artifacts
optimization_caveat: Same command-line optimization flags; embedded GCC optimize/target/unroll pragmas remain and can override their effective optimization level
contract: LC-valid N,Q<=500000, initial values and add deltas 0..1e9; add only, nonempty half-open sum; total stays below uint64 overflow
oracle: Independent Python Fenwick; exact decimal output including newline SHA-256
order: Rotate all successful candidates by run+case; fresh process, no warmup
wall_timing: perf_counter_ns before opening regular stdin/stdout files until process exits and descriptors close; includes launch, initialization, operations, parsing/formatting and OS file I/O; excludes compile, fixture generation, digest checks and output unlink
process_timing: Delta of RUSAGE_CHILDREN user/system CPU time for the one measured child; includes its file I/O CPU overhead; parent CPU excluded
filesystem: TemporaryDirectory under Linux /tmp, input/output regular files (not pipes, /dev/null or Windows-mounted worktree); default cached filesystem, no fsync/drop_caches
memory: No RSS comparison: getrusage can inherit Python parent peak
diagnostics: GCC/Clang caret source excerpts suppressed with diagnostic-only flags to avoid redistributing third-party code
